# Indexed diamond runtime deployment

The app directly uses base and middle; middle also uses base. Workspace own-DEPS roots start SDK-skippable, but a successfully selected local member must not be requeued as if it had been skipped. Repeated selection used to collide with the same package’s own loose payload. Debug, preserved debug and packed release must run2. Different package/file collisions remain errors in bundle-indexed-name-clash.
